name: @chbrain/khai-composite-squaring
description: khai composite content, the squaring domain: how a persona squares what happened with who they take themselves to be -- the cause placed where it need not disturb the self, the belief bent to fit a deed already done, and the standard suspended just here and just this once -- a wiring of the attribution, dissonance, and moral-disengagement engines, staged as the cause, the revision, and the suspension.

khai.tagline: Squaring as composite: how a persona squares what happened with who they take themselves to be -- the cause placed where it need not disturb the self (attribution), the belief bent to fit a deed that cannot be undone (dissonance), and the moral standard suspended just here and just this once (moral-disengagement) -- across the cause, the revision, and the suspension, and the drama is that each repair goes deeper and shows less, until the account is not a lie the persona tells but what the persona now holds.

card.wire: Attaches at Persona, on the Projection chapter, over three atoms it declares as dependencies -- the attribution, dissonance, and moral-disengagement engines, the account a persona gives of its own conduct read as one thing at three depths. The root (process_squaring.md) reads what a persona does with an outcome so that the self survives it: the cause placed somewhere it need not disturb the self-picture (attribution), the belief moved because the deed cannot be (dissonance), and the moral standard selectively switched off for this act alone (moral-disengagement). This composite adds no fourth engine; it wires the seam the three make -- a repair running deeper each time the shallower one will not hold -- and reads that the deepest repair is the one the persona is least able to see.
card.issue: Three bridges, the depths at which an account can be edited. The Cause: the outcome's why placed on the two axes of locus and stability -- inward and lasting (disposition), inward and passing (effort), outward and lasting (circumstance), outward and passing (chance) -- the placement setting the emotion that follows and the expectancy for next time, and the cheapest repair available, since a cause put outside or put down to a once-off leaves the self untouched (attribution). The Revision: when the deed was freely done and cannot be undone, the discomfort of the mismatch moves the cheapest cognition instead, so the belief bends to the act -- the dull task made genuinely interesting for a dollar, the chosen option upgraded and the rejected one downgraded the moment the choice is made, the goal prized in proportion to what it cost to reach (dissonance). The Suspension: the twist -- the morals not abandoned wholesale but selectively switched off at one of four points, the act relabelled, the agency displaced onto an order or a crowd, the harm shrunk below the threshold that would trip the sanction, or the victim placed outside the circle the sanction protects (moral-disengagement) -- where the sequence is seen for what it is: the persona keeps believing the act would be wrong for someone else, so there is no revised belief to argue with and no missing standard to point to. A persona places, revises, and suspends; the composite is the whole account by which a self survives what it did.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the composite. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root, so squaring reads wherever its atoms are cast. The link, advisory: a persona may link under Projection the depth at which their account is being repaired, and the audit surfaces where a play has a persona do something out of character and then simply carry on.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; coherence is judged. The kit verifies the floor: the law is declared, the composite's own members conform, and every hard link into the atoms resolves through a declared dependency -- here, through the attribution, dissonance, and moral-disengagement engines. Whether an account rings true -- a placement that truly spares, a revision truly held, a suspension truly local -- is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite.
card.setup: Install the composite; its atoms arrive as dependencies -- attribution, dissonance, and moral-disengagement, and through them their members. Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Cast the persona's account from the three engines -- the causal placement from attribution, the attitude bent to the deed from dissonance, the selective carve-out from moral-disengagement -- then read the bridge: the cause when the placement is doing the work, the revision when a belief has moved to cover an act, the suspension when a standard has been switched off for this one deed. Read the persona as sincerely holding the account, never as the word squaring alone -- and let the suspension carry the keystone: the account is not a lie the persona tells but what the persona now holds, which is why it cannot be corrected from outside.
